description.value:
Saves +2 status to Fortitude

Size Large

Speed 25 feet

AC +2 item

Melee vine-sweep (reach 15 ft, sweep) 3d8 bludgeoning, Grapple at reach

Green load at the start of each of your turns, one 10-foot square within 30 feet you can see becomes overgrown difficult terrain, permanently. Grey load vine-sweep also deals 2d6 acid, and unattended metal it touches takes a permanent −1 item penalty.

cinderfall.incomplete: `BLIGHTSHAPE-NULL` (no companion effect item exists to carry `BattleForm`) stacked on `BLOOMROT-NULL` (Green/Grey load selection). Matches the Worm Form precedent exactly: the action item correctly has `rules:[]`, but the real content has no valid file to live in among the 69 in scope.
